newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates firmer on C. Bank's moves.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates firmer on C. Bank's moves.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) rose in all maturities following a series of Central Bank rate increases which prompted banks to quote higher swap rates, traders said.
"PHIBOR are just mimicking the rising trend in their underlying rates," one trader said.

Earlier, the Central Bank raised its overnight borrowing rate to 11.50 percent, the second rise in less than a week, to quell speculation on the peso. It also increased its termed reverse repos late last week.
